widget.name: TRIMM Dropdown
widget.description: A customizable dropdown/select component for Mendix, styled with the TRIMM Design System. Features flexible option selection, icon support, and seamless integration with Mendix actions.

property.caption: Dropdown Items
property.description: List of selectable items to display in the dropdown menu

property.caption: Item Label
property.description: The text displayed for this dropdown item

property.caption: Item Action
property.description: Optional action executed when this item is selected

property.caption: Button Caption
property.description: The text displayed on the dropdown toggle button

property.caption: Button Icon
property.description: Optional icon displayed in the dropdown toggle button

property.caption: Show Caret Icon
property.description: Display the downward arrow indicator on the dropdown button
